_comment: Collections the preview harness renders with zero published products, so the
empty-collection nav rule is exercised by something rather than only described.
Everything else in the preview inherits a healthy count and the nav renders in full.
'condoms' is a leaf with a live sibling: one link goes, the group stays.
'sport' is a childless group: it goes whole, which is why the mobile drawer
shows one fewer Medicines & Health row than the taxonomy lists.
Read by setup/render_preview.mjs (sets the counts), setup/verify/nav-empty.py
(asserts they vanish) and setup/verify/mobile-nav.py (subtracts them from its
expected row count). One list, three readers: adding a handle here must not
mean remembering to fix a count somewhere else.
